title: Ragtime, honky-tonk and slow blues: what the music was called
summary: Foster says there was no Dixieland, only ragtime; rumbas, tangos, honky-tonk music and the slow drag are explained, with boogie as slow blues.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
